values.note: Reservable online up to 365 days ahead and for the same day ('Reservations can be made for today'), or at 1-888-432-2267.

booking.source: https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/pocomoke-river-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380121 (Booking Window: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 365 Day(s) in advance.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Only site M011 lists 50 amp; the other 18 electric sites are 30 amp.

hookups.source: https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/pocomoke-river-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380121 (per-site details for the 19 Milburn Landing Nanticoke Loop electric sites: 'Electrical Service (amp)' 30, and 50 at M011; no water or sewer service listed), read 2026-10-21

values.note: DNR: '34 campsites and 2 cozy minicabins'. The booking site lists 32 Nanticoke Loop campsites (19 electric, 13 non-electric, two of them tent/trailer only); listed max vehicle lengths are 20-30 ft except one 40-ft electric site.

sites.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/eastern/pocomokeriver.aspx ('Camping: 34 campsites and 2 cozy minicabins available from April to mid-December.') + https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/pocomoke-river-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380121 (site list and per-site details: Max Vehicle Length), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed on DNR's Pocomoke River page and the booking site: 365-day window and same-day booking; 34 campsites to 40 ft; electric 30 amp (one 50-amp site), no water/sewer listed; season (manual, Apr-mid-Dec) matches DNR and the 2026 reservable dates (Apr 3-Dec 12). Fees (human-checked 2026-10-12) match DNR's camping charges for this area; the booking site's park-wide rate table reads $19.50-20.50 non-electric and $25.50-26.50 electric for both areas, which matches neither area's DNR figure (unresolved, not changed). Facilities: the park-wide amenity list (showers, dump, store) cannot be placed at Milburn Landing, so left unset. Weekend/holiday minimums not stated for this park (left inherited). Phone 410-632-2566 matches. Note kept.
flags: Website: the entry's website is the park-wide booking page; DNR's park page (with a Milburn Landing section) is https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/eastern/pocomokeriver.aspx.
